conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly growth. It significantly reduces leverage and focuses on income and broad market exposure, aiming for lower drawdowns. Expect slower growth compared to other modes.

plan: Maintain broad index exposure at 25%.

Increase position in strong tech name CRWD to 15%.
Maintain minimal exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL).

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets ~2.5% monthly growth by blending broad market exposure with quality tech and limited leverage. It aims for risk-first growth, reducing concentration and exiting the weakest positions. Drawdowns are expected to be moderate.

Reduce income ETF to 10% to fund growth.
Increase position in strong tech name CRWD to 15%.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly growth by increasing leverage and concentration in high-conviction names and inverse ETFs. Expect significantly higher potential upside but also substantially larger drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses due to leverage and ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Reduce broad index exposure to 20% to prioritize income.
Increase income ETF to 30% for steady distributions.
Eliminate all leveraged ETFs and high-beta growth names.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets ~1% monthly distributions by prioritizing income-generating ETFs and reducing volatile growth assets. It aims for low drawdowns and reliable cash flow, not aggressive growth. NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
